learning_outcomes.text: The students get knowledge on specific technological procedures used in instrumentation and their connection with design of instruments.

Students will try out some of the specific technologies - small parts manufacturing, production of thin films, holographic production methods, and glass cutting technology used in production of instruments.

syllabus_topics: Fine parts production techniques the watch lathe, automatic Swiss type lathe
Statistical production of balls and the production and assembly of bearings.
Production of precision planar, spherical and aspherical surfaces.
Production and processing of glass and optical fibers.
Production of single crystals and its properties.
Production of springs and spring elements for instruments.
Special technologies for production instrument components - EDM, laser, fluid beam.
Special technologies for production instrument components plasma, ultrasound, rapid prototyping, micromachining.
Techniques surveying and production of holes, technology of gluing and production of composites.
